entityName: UNIV FIRENZE - Dipartimento di Scienze Biomediche Sperimentali e Cliniche (DSBS)
entityDescription:
The Department of Experimental and Clinical Biomedical Sciences "Mario Serio," consists of faculty and researchers pertaining to 15 scientific disciplinary fields of clinical and preclinical areas who carry out teaching activities within the School of Human Health Sciences, the School of Mathematical Physical and Natural Sciences, the School of Engineering, the School of Psychology and the School of Agriculture. Specialization Schools of Health Area and Level I and II Master's degrees are incardinated.
The Department, which is divided into four sections with the task of coordinating, rationalizing and optimizing the use of resources located in different areas, is organized into 42 Research Units that include, in addition to tenured staff, fixed-term researchers, research fellows, PhD students, postgraduates, students and other scholars working under agreements.
Activities in research range from Biochemistry, Molecular Biology and Pathology as basic sciences, embracing more purely clinical disciplines such as Gynecology and Obstetrics, Endocrinology, Diagnostic Imaging and Radiation Therapy and Nephrology. A unifying point among these disciplines as a binding element between areas of scientific excellence is Gender Medicine, a modern view of medicine geared toward capturing gender differences with respect to health and disease processes. It is the administrative home of the Doctoral Program in Biomedical Sciences, and in collaboration with Pisa and Siena, participates in two Pegaso doctoral programs
The Department has the following goals:
1 To create transversality between basic and clinical disciplines, using outstanding research and exploiting the excellence present in both fields of endeavor,
2 Create synergies between different research groups
3 Promote the recruitment of new researchers, in all areas of research, with a view to renewing and enhancing the design capacity of research units,
4 The Department has been selected among the 2018 Excellent Departments (MIUR call). The selected topic is Gender Medicine. The project aims to strengthen SSDs characterized by a gender footprint, create a "facility" to support both intra- and inter-departmental research, stimulate an exchange of translational and clinical expertise, and create a research funding fund.
5 Support the research of young researchers with a view to achieving standards of excellence.
6 Maintain the high quality of teaching delivered by the Department's faculty members by enhancing the relationship between research and teaching and supporting with adequate staffing points all teaching delivered by faculty members
7 Support the teaching activities carried out within the teaching laboratories and improve the teaching facilities and laboratories dedicated to students

We are ready to design, develop and manufacture any application tailored sensors offering to our partners a high quality engineering and manufacturing environment along with our modern design approach.

LAER S.p.A. works in the Aeronautical field since 1989, born as family run Company today is a private Company with 207 employees on two sites. Laer is able to manage fully vertically integrated work packages, from design to manufacturing of complex assembled structures and UNI EN ISO 9100:2009 - 9001:2008 and NADCAP qualified. The organization has maintained the direct vertical relationship between Top Management and R&D department thus guaranteeing quick feedback flexibility and in production reaction time. 
Two production sites are located in Campania, Southern Italy Region. Headquarter, Technical, Administrative and Staff Offices are located in Airola, where Machining and Metal sheet, Thermal and Special Processes and Assembly are performed according to Quality standard requirements.
Acerra plant (on 2.000 Sq.m covered area) is dedicated to Composite materials production by the conventional Autoclave methods and by innovative Liquid Resin Infusion technique. All items, fabricated and inspected in each site, join in Airola for final assembly on different Program Workshops, which take up about 60% of total cover area that is 15.400 square meters.
Laer has a prominent position in Aerospace Industry of Campania Region, supplying items and large assemblies in both metal and composite material, fabricated and inspected according to relevant standards. Main products are: fuselage sections, such as central, fore and aft - movable surfaces, such as aileron, spoiler and flaps – machined parts for primary structures such as Horizontal and Vertical Stabilizers. Laer is LEONARDO TIER1 on ATR, Airbus, Boeing B767 e B787, C27J, Bombardier C-Series, Aermacchi M346 programs and direct supplier for FACC on SSJ100 program and for Piaggio Aerospace on MPA e P180 programs. Each year LAER engineering manages about 15.000 Part Number, counting about 1000 tools designed and fabricated. During last three years period, Turnover overcame 20 Million following a growing trend assessed in 2016. 
LAER aims to ensure continuous improvement of its own know—how and to acquire innovative industrial capacity in the context of national and international growth, in order to improve competitiveness on the international market. In last three years period LAER had the opportunity to develop several projects, funded on Public Entities (MiSE, MIUR, Armareo, Regione Campania, European Commission) in collaboration with Research Centres and Private Company. As production Private Company operating in Aerospace, the research thematic area is aimed to develop innovative manufacturing processes applied to both fabrication and assembly stage. R&D team, specialized in aeronautical fabrication processes and coordinated by a Philosophy Doctor in Smart Systems for Automation of Production, is supported by different skills, coming from Process Engineering, Production, Quality Control and all impacted departments.

Urbetho e.K., registered in Alling, Germany, was founded in 2019 by Dr. Ursula Benz. It provides business development consultancy for Geo-IT companies who want to scale up their business and integrate their services into business solutions of other verticals like agronomics, IoT, logistics, telecom, utilities and others.

Geo-IT companies get support by Urbetho and its partner network to evolve their business from one-off projects to reusable solutions and finally to repeatable geoservices with a high degree of automation and well packaged for a scalable sales approach. 

The rapidly growing number of public funded and private market- and Geo-IT platforms are a great opportunity for many of those geoservices. Urbetho explores for its customers how and which platforms can be of best help for the certain services to simplify and speed up the intended go-to-market strategy and to reach business scalability fast and at low risk. 

For example, market platforms, as e.g. ArcGIS Marketplace, cloudeo, NoR and eoMall can serve as worldwide marketing and sales channels and take away a lot of the technical and financial administration processes and overhead. They allow their platform members to fully focus onto the development of the solutions and services to accommodate their customers’ needs. The IaaS, DaaS and SaaS offerings of Geo-IT platforms, e.g. AWS, Google, GBDX from Maxar and the DIAS – funded by ESA to support especially the European business – save with their fast access to a multitude of data and re-usable software tools production cost and time and provide scalability and reliability for the service delivery.

Together with its partners Urbetho helps its customers to address these topics and to pave their path to a scalable business and – if applicable – to accelerate a successful onboarding of such services onto the best fitting marketplaces and Geo-IT platforms.

Telecom ParisTech is one of France's leading graduate engineering schools and is considered the school in the field of Communication and Information Technologies. Its disciplines include all the sciences and techniques that fall within the term "Information and Communications": Computer Science Networks, Communications, Electronics, Signal and Image Processing, as well as the study of economic and social aspects associated with modern technology.

 The school was founded more than a hundred years ago and is classed among the Grandes Ecoles d'Ingénieurs. Because of its high scientific standard and the extremely competitive admission procedures, ENST can be compared to the highest level engineering schools and universities that one would find abroad.
As an institution of higher education, the school is publicly funded, with close links with a number of partner institutions: it is part of a federation of schools in telecommunications, called the Institut Mines-Télécom and a member of ParisTech, a multi-campus networks of nine graduate engineering schools, all located in the Paris area. 

The Telecom ParisTech laboratories are part of Institut Mines Telecom-Recherche, research unit also gathering laboratories from the ENST-Bretagne, the INT and from the subsidiaries (Eurécom, ENIC, ¿).

Telecom ParisTech today has a faculty of about 150 full-time staff (full professors, associate and assistant professors), over 200 part-time lecturers and a student body of about 1000 students (including 750 in the three year diploma program, 100 in one of the master's level programs, and 200 Ph.D. students. 

Telecom ParisTech's four departments carry out research and teaching activities in the school's central areas of expertise :
¿	Department of Communications and Electronics (COMELEC)
¿	Department of Computer Science and Networks (INFRES)
¿	Department of Signal and Image Processing (TSI)
¿	Department of Economics and Social Sciences (EGSH) 

Telecom ParisTech's scientific policy is in phase with the rapid evolution of the sector of Information Technologies and the central role played by networks and information systems today. Research builds upon the major disciplines of digital communications, electronics, computer science and engineering, networks, digital signal and image processing and the economics of information systems, with applications in many systems, such as :
¿	high speed optical networks 
¿	local loops 
¿	satellites 
¿	mobile communications 
¿	multimedia and hypermedia 
¿	internet and the web and many of their areas of application (distance learning, health, environment, etc.) 

Over the last few decades, Telecom ParisTech has gained a recognized position internationally in its technical domains. In addition to working on the development in the basic sciences, research at Telecom ParisTech also aims at broadening its field of study, moving in particular towards system integration, innovative services on the internet and in other media, and the analysis of users communication practices and their social impact. Telecom ParisTech thus covers all aspects of Information Technologies. 
Telecom ParisTech is committed to maintaining an optimal balance between scientific research, whose themes remain fairly stable, and applied research, which changes more rapidly.

entityDescription:
Fotosintetica & Microbiologica S.r.l. (F&M) is a Spin-off company of the University of Florence founded in 2004 to exploit the know-how on microalgae physiology and mass cultivation developed since 1980 by a research group coordinated by Prof. Mario Tredici. F&M technologies are backed up by more than 30 years of studies in algae cultivation and characterization. Our laboratories and outdoor experimental facilities are located within the Polo Scientifico e Tecnologico dell’ Università di Firenze in Sesto Firentino (Firenze).
F&M provides consultancy on microalgae cultivation for production of biofuels, biofertilisers, functional feeds and foods, biomass for aquaculture, polyunsatured fatty acids, pigments, natural drugs and cosmetics. 
With our staff we are able to provide technical and scientific assistance services relating to: isolation, selection and characterization of algal strains, modification and optimization of algal production process, development and process/product innovation, contract manufacturing and training. F&M supplies turnkey algal cultivation systems, following all the phases: design, construction, start-up and maintenance. The need to produce at ever lower costs has led the company to develop "scalable", reliable and cost-effective cultivation systems such as the Green Wall Panel (GWP®) panel photobioreactors (ITFI20030047 and ITFI20090167 patents) and column photobioreactors F&M-AC. Our reactors are used in Italy and abroad for research (Kalmar University, Sweden; Wageningen University, Holland; Bergen University, Norway; KAUST, Saudi Arabia; VEOLIA, France) and production (Necton SA, Portugal; Archimede Ricerche Srl , Italy, Agricultural Society Serenissima, Italy).Because of its know-how, proprietary photobioreactor technologies, and its collection of over 1300 microalgal and cyanobacterial strains, F&M is the ideal partner for starting applied research and commercial activity on microalgae.
F&M was partner of several UE research project: BIOFAT, FUEL4ME, SPLASH, NOMORFILM and has participated in the Italian project “MAMBO: MicroAlghe Materia Prima perBioOlio” funded by Italian biodiesel producers.
